mapper.select: SELECT /* getReadingStatsSetting */ U.USER_NUMB , COALESCE(S.RSTA_YSNO, #{privateYsno}) AS PUBLIC_YSNO , U.USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_USSETX S ON S.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getReadingYearList */ YEAR(D.READ_DATE) AS READ_YEAR FROM TB_RDATDX D WHERE D.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY YEAR(D.READ_DATE) ORDER BY READ_YEAR DESC
SELECT /* getDailyTimeList */ D.READ_DATE , D.READ_SECS FROM TB_RDATDX D WHERE D.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND D.READ_DATE BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} ORDER BY D.READ_DATE
SELECT /* getStatusCountList */ R.REPT_STAT , COUNT(*) AS REPT_CNT FROM TM_REPORT R WHERE R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND R.REPT_STAT IN (#{readStat}, #{doneStat}, #{stopStat}) GROUP BY R.REPT_STAT
SELECT /* getReadingDateList */ D.READ_DATE FROM TB_RDATDX D WHERE D.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND D.READ_SECS > 0 ORDER BY D.READ_DATE

SELECT /* getTopBookTimeList */ MAX(R.REPT_NUMB) AS REPT_NUMB , R.BOOK_NUMB , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM , SUM(GREATEST(T.READ_SECS, 0)) AS READ_SECS FROM TM_RDTMRX T JOIN TM_REPORT R ON R.REPT_NUMB = T.REPT_NUMB AND R.USER_NUMB = T.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON B.BOOK_NUMB = R.BOOK_NUMB WHERE T.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND T.TMRX_STAT = #{completedStat} AND T.ENDX_DATE >= #{timerStart} AND T.ENDX_DATE < #{timerEnd} AND T.READ_SECS > 0 GROUP BY R.BOOK_NUMB , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM ORDER BY READ_SECS DESC , R.BOOK_NUMB DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT /* getRatingCountList */ FLOOR(CAST(R.REPT_GRDE AS DECIMAL(2, 1))) AS REPT_GRDE , COUNT(*) AS REPT_CNT FROM TM_REPORT R WHERE R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND R.REPT_GRDE REGEXP '^(0\\.5|[1-4](\\.0|\\.5)?|5(\\.0)?)$' GROUP BY FLOOR(CAST(R.REPT_GRDE AS DECIMAL(2, 1))) ORDER BY REPT_GRDE DESC
